claim: skill-creator is the single portable owner for model-facing instruction and skill authoring; public prose remains owned by humanizer.

selection.source: active portable skill plus a behavior-level review of Codex's bundled system skill
selection.boundary: Author concise model-facing content after placement is known; do not own public prose, placement, admission policy, or Codex-native scaffolding/UI metadata/validation.
selection.portable_behavior_migrated: Preserve user scope and authorization; externally mutating retry workflows require a risk-proportional stopping condition.
selection.native_behavior_retained: Codex .system/skill-creator keeps its initializer, openai.yaml/UI metadata, bundled validator, and Codex installation defaults.

verification.positive_trigger: creating or revising durable agent instructions
verification.near_miss: public prose routes to humanizer; stable facts route to memory

result.selection_reason: The portable owner stays narrow while absorbing the useful general scope safeguards; Codex-only packaging behavior remains in the bundled native owner and is explicitly disambiguated.
